features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum lifter but does not mention it being cordless, handheld, or battery-powered.

features.item: flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference describes a vacuum suction cup with a flexible suction plate for temporary fixation on a smooth, air-impermeable surface, which implies a flexible sealing lip.
features.quote_src: Vakuumsauger zur temporären Fixierung an einer im wesentlichen glatten, luftundurchlässigen Befestigungsfläche, insbesondere als Vakuumheber, mit einer Trägerschale und einem flexiblen Saugteller

features.item: electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
features.note: The reference mentions an actuating mechanism to create a partial vacuum but does not specify an electric vacuum pump or its mounting within a rigid body.

features.item: pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference discloses a vacuum indicator mechanically coupled to the suction cup to show partial vacuum, which implies monitoring the vacuum level, but it doesn't explicitly state a 'pressure sensor'.
features.quote_src: wobei eine Vakuumanzeigeeinrichtung zur Anzeige des Teilvakuums mit einem Anzeigeelement (16) vorgesehen und das Anzeigeelement der Vakuumanzeigeeinrichtung mit dem Saugteller mechanisch gekoppelt ist

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference states that the display device causes a display by the display element when the partial vacuum decreases from reaching a threshold value.
features.quote_src: dass diese bei nachlassendem Teilvakuum ab Erreichen eines Schwellwertes eine Anzeige durch das Anzeigeelement bewirkt

features.item: warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
features.note: (non-English passage at claim 6) The reference defines the threshold as corresponding to a partial vacuum that is just permissible for the operation of the vacuum suction device, which implies a relation to a critical operational limit.
features.quote_src: dass der Schwellwert einem für einen Betrieb des Vakuumsaugers gerade noch zulässigen Teilvakuum entspricht

features.item: warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference states that an indication is caused when the vacuum falls below a threshold, but it does not explicitly state that the indicator *remains active* as long as the vacuum persists below the threshold.
features.quote_src: dass diese bei nachlassendem Teilvakuum ab Erreichen eines Schwellwertes eine Anzeige durch das Anzeigeelement bewirkt

features.item: rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
features.note: The reference does not mention a rechargeable battery or any power source for the vacuum lifter.

features.item: warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference states the display element is integrated into the actuator, which is part of the device, but does not explicitly state its visibility during lifting operation.
features.quote_src: dass das Anzeigeelement (16) oder zumindest ein Teil der Anzeigeeinrichtung (15) in dem Betätigungsorgan (7) integriert ist

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum lifter but does not specify a single-hand portable design or the absence of external hoses or cords.

overall.why: The reference describes a vacuum lifter with a mechanical vacuum indicator and a threshold-based warning, which aligns with several features of the subject invention, but lacks details on power source, portability, and specific pump type.
